evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No historical reference has been established; observations begin at contract activation.
evidenceCoverage.reason: Prospective goal contract without an established historical reference.

caveat: The evidence measures repository outcomes against a frozen goal, not the causal impact of an agent or contract activation.

intent.goal: Maintain compiler compatibility with real public repositories using gh-aw, including the declared automatic migration pass.
intent.acceptance: Every native-selected workflow in each fixed selected repository independently compiles under the exact fixed assessed compiler after its one declared fix --write pass.

evaluation.reason: Current-source-scoped contract activation, not verified workflow adoption. The phenomenon predates the instrument; historical baseline evidence is unacquired, not exhausted.

evidence.opportunity: A frozen cohort of the source-defined top 20 public, non-archived repositories discovered through gh-aw lock-file markers; each repository has its entire native compiler-selected workflow inventory assessed.
filters: Discovery must preserve candidate identities, public/archive status, stars, ranking and selected revisions at or after contract activation, before reading outcomes.
Freeze the initial cohort and exact compiler build/binary/environment; subsequent star rankings or compiler fallback belong to separate comparison eras.
One unmodified compile --strict, one fix --write with the same compiler and no manual edits, then compile --strict. Preserve original inventories, generated outputs and complete transformation diff.

Only original protected independent compiler results at the assessed source revision count. Agent-writable cache summaries, issues, PRs, run conclusions and tracking markers are discovery, not acceptance.
Compiler validation failures are incompatibilities only when setup/access/import resolution are independently complete. Missing or infrastructure-failed evidence remains unknown.
evidence.collection: Offline batch replay of digest-bound original protected compiler reports and exhaustive native workflow inventories. No GitHub API, execution, installation, discovery, compilation or network access occurs during collection/scoring.

scope.collectionIdentity: github/gh-aw is the intent-source and aggregate collection identity, not a substitute target repository.
scope.outcomeIdentities: Only the independently preserved public selected-cohort identities; none are resolved yet. Observations with a cohort name the actual outcome repositories.

acceptance.ranking: Stars descending; preserve the source's actual selection for tied stars instead of inventing a tie-breaker.
acceptance.compiler: Exact original assessed compiler revision, binary SHA-256, native version, build toolchain and environment; freeze at the first independently verified selection before outcome inspection.
acceptance.transformation: One native fix --write invocation, including its registry's internal convergence passes and documented scaffolding/cleanup side effects; no arbitrary manual repair, workflow deletion or disabled checks.
acceptance.inventory: Full before/after native selected Markdown inventory plus imports, configuration, action/container pins and generated lock identities. Inventory loss or narrowed selection cannot improve attainment.
acceptance.evidenceAuthority: An independently protected checker source and report must be reviewed and pinned in the native input ledger before replay. Digest integrity alone does not establish protected provenance.
acceptance.nativeProjection: A protected replay may add --json to compile --strict for the original compiler's ValidationResult array; this changes output formatting only, not checks. Whole process exit and batch errors remain gates.
acceptance.maturation: A contemporaneous immutable cutoff assessment, no later evidence backdated; unavailable cutoffs remain visible. No stale-last-known-success fallback.

antecedent.reason: Humans or any other automation can produce compilable sources and compatible compilers. Exact historical discovery, source inventories and compiler receipts have not been acquired.
antecedent.baselineProbe: Offline preserved-source and discovery inspection found no accepted original native compile reports. Network acquisition was explicitly withheld; this is not evidence exhaustion.

metricDisposition.primary: Repository-wide strict compile compatibility after the exact declared migration pass.
metricDisposition.diagnostic: Independently demonstrated compiling workflow subtotal, retained even when full repository compatibility is unknown.

model.architecture: Deterministic native compatibility snapshot over one frozen discovery cohort; exact-period original evidence only.
model.recommendation: Report accepted attainment and independent partial evidence; no invented keep bar, utility weight, savings, runtime certification or causal contribution.

summary.nativeLabel: Selected repositories compiling after native migration (%)

metrics.name: Selected repository compilation compatibility
metrics.formula: 100 * compatibleRepositories / eligibleCount; only when all 20 selected repositories have complete independent native assessments.

metrics.name: Independently compiling workflows
metrics.formula: knownCompatibleWorkflows from verified original native per-workflow results; null when no workflows were independently assessed.

limitations: Complete current workflow, imports, compiled source and native command/specification are preserved and reviewed. No separate protected native compiler checker exists in this compiled workflow.
No native selected-repository snapshot, compiler build, target inventories or protected original compile reports are retained yet. Population is unknown, not an assumed 20.
Discovery verifies surviving output identities only; current issue state and mutable tracking markers are not backdated.
Changing cohorts, compiler versions, toolchains or eligibility rules cannot establish longitudinal improvement.
Compile acceptance is not runtime correctness, full compatibility, source repair delivery, workflow contribution or exclusive causation.
Snapshots are retained state, not additive fresh work or non-overlapping delivered contributions. No costs are measured and no keep/change policy is rated.
